compute_matthews_correlation: compute the Matthews correlation coefficient for binary and multiclass classification predictions
compute_multilabel_correlation: compute per-feature Matthews correlation coefficients for multilabel classification without averaging
compute_correlation_with_weights: compute Matthews correlation with sample weights to weight individual predictions
compute_macro_average_correlation: compute the macro-averaged Matthews correlation across all multilabel features
get_metric_info: get the metric info including description, citation, and input feature schema
